description: Refuses a contract whose hourly, daily or monthly rate is below the regional minimum wage in force on the contract's first day.

lookup.name: 最低賃金を下回る労働契約 (contract below the minimum wage)
lookup.message: The wage is below the regional minimum wage in force on the term's first day; such a term is void (最低賃金法 art.4(2)).

references.title: 最低賃金法 arts.4, 7, 13 with 施行規則 arts.1–2: the minimum in force on the term's day (day) of the workplace's prefecture, less a permitted reduction, compared per hour.

description: Refuses a day worked beyond 8 hours while no filed 36 agreement covers the date.

lookup.name: Worked beyond 8 hours a day with no 36 agreement in force
lookup.message: Worked beyond 8 hours a day with no 36 agreement in force (労働基準法 arts.32(2), 36(1)).

references.title: 法定労働時間 1日8時間 (労働基準法 art.32(2)); beyond it only under a filed 36 agreement (art.36(1); entity_extension_data.overtime_agreement_from/to) or in an emergency (art.33). Not for managers (art.41(ii)) or a variable, flex or deemed regime (entity_extension_data.working_time_regime). A worked day is a fact to correct, not to refuse: warn.

description: Refuses a week worked beyond 40 hours (44 for a listed small establishment) while no filed 36 agreement covers the date.

lookup.name: Worked beyond 40 hours in the week with no 36 agreement in force
lookup.message: Worked beyond 40 hours in the week with no 36 agreement in force (労働基準法 arts.32(1), 36(1)).

references.title: 法定労働時間 1週40時間 (労働基準法 art.32(1)), 44 hours for a 特例措置対象事業場 (施行規則 art.25の2; entity_extension_data.weekly_limit_44); the week is the calendar week from entity_extension_data.week_start (昭和63年1月1日 基発1号), read on its last day.

description: Refuses a planned ordinary shift longer than 8 hours because the hours beyond 8 are statutory overtime the planned price does not include.

lookup.name: A shift planned beyond 8 ordinary hours: its hours beyond 8 are statutory overtime the pay does not price
lookup.message: The planned shift has more than 8 ordinary hours: the hours beyond 8 are statutory overtime the planned day does not price; plan at most 8 ordinary hours and let the rest be overtime (労働基準法 arts.32(2), 37(1)).

references.title: 労働基準法 art.32(2) (8 hours a day) and art.37(1) (割増賃金 on every hour beyond it) and art.24 (full payment): overtime is every hour past the planned shift’s ordinary hours, so ordinary hours planned beyond 8 a day would carry the statutory premium unpriced. Not for managers (art.41(ii)) or a variable, flex or deemed regime (entity_extension_data.working_time_regime).

description: Refuses a shift whose break is under 45 minutes after 6 hours or under one hour after 8 hours.

lookup.name: Too short a break: 45 minutes beyond 6 hours of work, 1 hour beyond 8
lookup.message: Too short a break: 45 minutes beyond 6 hours of work, 1 hour beyond 8 (労働基準法 art.34(1)).

references.title: 労働基準法 art.34(1): a break of at least 45 minutes where the working time exceeds 6 hours and 1 hour where it exceeds 8, within the working time; the break is the gaps between the day’s clock intervals, and the working time is the time inside them (not the paid hours, which count the planned hours on a day left early). Not for managers (art.41).

description: Refuses a week with no rest day.

lookup.name: No rest day in the week
lookup.message: No rest day in the week (労働基準法 art.35(1)).

references.title: 労働基準法 art.35(1): at least one rest day each week, unless the work rules use 4 rest days in 4 weeks (art.35(2); entity_extension_data.variable_rest_days). Rest-day work needs a 36 agreement and the 35% premium (arts.36, 37).

description: Refuses overtime beyond 8 hours or rest-day work recorded for a worker under 18.

lookup.name: Overtime beyond 8 hours or rest-day work recorded for a worker under 18, which the law forbids
lookup.message: Overtime beyond 8 hours a day, or rest-day work, recorded for a worker under 18, which the law forbids (労働基準法 art.60(1)).

references.title: 労働基準法 art.60(1): the 36 agreement (art.36) does not apply to a worker under 18, so no work beyond 8 hours a day or on the statutory rest day; overtime within 8 hours (past a shorter schedule) is lawful. Every hour past the schedule is approved overtime, so recording it is the forbidden instruction and the file is refused (an emergency under art.33 is not distinguished).

description: Refuses a worker under 18 working beyond 8 hours a day or 40 hours a week.

lookup.name: A worker under 18 worked beyond 8 hours a day or 40 a week
lookup.message: A worker under 18 worked beyond 8 hours a day or 40 a week (労働基準法 art.60).

references.title: 労働基準法 art.60(1), (3): no variable-hours or 36-agreement extension for a minor beyond the art.60(3) exceptions.

description: Refuses night work between 22:00 and 05:00 recorded for a worker under 18.

lookup.name: A worker under 18 worked between 22:00 and 05:00
lookup.message: A worker under 18 worked between 22:00 and 05:00 (労働基準法 art.61(1)).

references.title: 労働基準法 art.61(1): no night work for a worker under 18, except a male of 16 or over in a shift system (proviso) and the art.61(3)–(4) cases.

description: Refuses overtime beyond 8 hours or rest-day work recorded for a pregnant or post-partum worker who asked to be excused.

lookup.name: Overtime beyond 8 hours or rest-day work recorded for a pregnant or post-partum worker who asked to be excused
lookup.message: Overtime beyond 8 hours a day, or rest-day work, recorded for a pregnant or post-partum worker who asked to be excused (労働基準法 art.66(2)).

references.title: 労働基準法 art.66(2): on the request of an 妊産婦 (workplace case PREGNANCY_WORK_LIMIT_REQUEST) the employer shall not make her work overtime beyond the statutory hours or on a rest day; every hour past the schedule is approved overtime, so a day beyond 8 hours or rest-day work is refused.

description: Refuses night work recorded for a pregnant or post-partum worker who asked to be excused.

lookup.name: A pregnant or post-partum worker who asked to be excused worked at night
lookup.message: A pregnant or post-partum worker who asked to be excused worked at night (労働基準法 art.66(3)).

references.title: 労働基準法 art.66(3): no night work on the 妊産婦’s request.

description: Refuses work beyond the scheduled hours recorded for a worker who asked to be excused from overtime for childcare or care.

lookup.name: Overtime approved for a worker who asked not to work beyond the schedule for childcare or care
lookup.message: Overtime approved for a worker who asked not to work beyond the schedule for childcare or care (育児・介護休業法 arts.16の8, 16の9).

references.title: 育児・介護休業法 arts.16の8–16の9: a worker caring for a child before school age (from April 2025) or a family member who asks (workplace case CHILDCARE_NO_OVERTIME_REQUEST) shall not be made to work beyond the scheduled hours: the approval is refused.

description: Refuses night work recorded for a worker who asked to be excused from night work for childcare or care.

lookup.name: A worker who asked to be excused from night work for childcare or care worked between 22:00 and 05:00
lookup.message: A worker who asked to be excused from night work for childcare or care worked between 22:00 and 05:00 (育児・介護休業法 arts.19, 20).

references.title: 育児・介護休業法 arts.19–20 (workplace case CHILDCARE_NIGHT_WORK_EXEMPTION_REQUEST)

description: Refuses more than 2 hours of overtime in a day on work harmful to health.

lookup.name: More than 2 hours of overtime in a day on work harmful to health
lookup.message: More than 2 hours of overtime in a day on work harmful to health (労働基準法 art.36(6)(i)).

references.title: 労働基準法 art.36(6)(i) with 施行規則 art.18: 坑内労働 and the listed harmful work may run at most 2 hours beyond the daily limit, even under a 36 agreement (employee_extension_data.hazardous_work).

description: Refuses less rest between the end of one day's work and the next than the employer's interval or, for drivers, the 9-hour statutory floor.

lookup.name: Less rest between the end of one day’s work and the next than the company interval or the driver floor
lookup.message: Less rest between the end of one day’s work and the next than the interval the employer applies or, for drivers, the 9-hour statutory floor (勤務間インターバル).

references.title: 労働時間等の設定の改善に関する特別措置法 art.2(1) (the employer’s duty to try to secure rest between shifts; entity_extension_data.work_interval_hours, the interval its rules adopt); for drivers the 改善基準告示 (令和4年厚生労働省告示第367号) sets at least 9 hours (entity_extension_data.overtime_sector DRIVER).

description: Refuses leave recorded on a day that also has attendance.

lookup.name: Leave recorded on a day with attendance: the leave or the clock times are wrong.
lookup.message: Leave recorded on a day with attendance: the leave or the clock times are wrong.

references.title: 労働基準法 art.39 (annual leave is a release from the duty to work on that day) and art.108 with 施行規則 art.54(1)(ii)–(iii) (the wage ledger records the days and hours worked): a day cannot be both.

description: Refuses an entity pay frequency other than at least monthly on a fixed day.
validate:
const schedule = get(ctx.subject.employer, 'payment_schedule', {});
return get(schedule, 'frequency', null) !== ctx.lookup.forbidden_frequency;

lookup.name: 毎月1回以上・一定期日払の原則 (wages at least monthly)
lookup.message: Wages are paid less often than monthly: the law requires a payment at least once a month on a fixed day (労働基準法 art.24(2)).

references.title: 労働基準法 art.24(2): wages are paid at least once a month on a fixed day, except bonuses and the payments 施行規則 art.8 lists; an INTEGER_MONTHS pay frequency is for those only.

description: Refuses to consume a substitute-leave entry until the overtime-month allocation and premium settlement have been reviewed outside the automatic path.

lookup.name: Automatic overtime substitute-leave allocation is unsupported
lookup.message: Automatic substitute-leave offsets are unsupported. Review the overtime-month allocation and premium settlement outside this automatic path before payroll; do not treat the current-period offset as a correct result.

references.title: Automatic overtime substitute-leave allocation is unsupported

description: Refuses prenatal leave days outside the 6-week (14-week multiple pregnancy) window before the expected birth.
condition: return get(first(ctx.reads.leave_catalog) ?? {}, 'code', null) === ctx.lookup.catalog_code && get(ctx.entry, 'reverses', null) == null;

lookup.name: 産前休業の請求期間 (prenatal leave window)
lookup.message: Prenatal leave runs from 6 weeks before the expected birth recorded on the contract, 14 for a multiple pregnancy (労働基準法 art.65(1)).

references.title: 労働基準法 art.65(1): on request, from 6 weeks before the expected birth (14 weeks for a multiple pregnancy); the day of birth counts as prenatal and a birth later than expected extends the leave.

description: Refuses annual leave taken in hours beyond 5 days in the grant year.
condition: return get(first(ctx.reads.leave_catalog) ?? {}, 'code', null) === ctx.lookup.catalog_code && get(ctx.entry, 'reverses', null) == null;

lookup.name: 時間単位年休の上限 (annual leave in hours, yearly cap)
lookup.message: Annual leave taken in hours is capped at 5 days a year from the grant day (労働基準法 art.39(4); 施行規則 art.24の4).

references.title: 労働基準法 art.39(4)(ii) with 施行規則 art.24の4: up to 5 days a year, days carried over included.
